outlet: Whitman County Gazette, 'Road work and maintenance levies hit November ballots' (Teresa Simpson, 2023-10-26)
notes: Paywalled excerpt: Albion's 2023 levy (Resolution No. 23-04) was a one-year proposition for continued police, fire and code enforcement services, $20,000, about $0.86 per $1,000 ($86 a year per $100,000).
